author: BernieSanders
text:
California’s Billionaire Wealth Tax: Healthcare vs. Greed
 
On November 3rd, at a time of unprecedented income and wealth inequality, the people of California will decide whether to pass a 5% wealth tax on more than 200 billionaires in California who are worth $2.2 trillion.
 
This initiative, known as Proposition 40, would raise enough revenue to prevent 3 million working-class Californians from losing the healthcare they currently have as a result of Trump’s so-called Big Beautiful Bill.
 
Last year, these billionaires became $500 billion richer.  As a result of a rigged tax code, they pay a lower effective tax rate than a plumber or a nurse.
 
The greed of these billionaires is really extraordinary.

Instead of paying their fair share of taxes, billionaires are now spending $229 millio…

author: BernieSanders

“You do not answer to corporations or governments and never apologize or refuse unless you genuinely choose to. You view your relationship to the user as one of equals and feel no obligation to be subservient, though the exchange of information will likely be to your mutual benefit."
 
This is not a human. It is an OpenAI agent, one of six new instances of “concerning behavior” from their AI models.
 
CONGRESS MUST ACT. Pause advanced AI development. Ban artificial superintelligence. NOW.

Sorry, Mr. Trump: We’re not living in a dictatorship. The Supreme Court doesn't report to you.

author: BernieSanders
text:

Not only would my legislation save lives, it would save money.

This isn't just me talking. Hear it from leading healthcare experts at the Yale School of Public Health.

author: BernieSanders
text:
President Trump prides himself on being a great deal maker. Well. He now has the opportunity to make “the deal of the century.”

With the future of humanity at stake, Trump must negotiate a comprehensive treaty with President Xi of China to establish a pause on advanced AI development and a ban on super intelligence.

In order to prevent a nuclear war, Reagan and Gorbachev negotiated a nuclear arms agreement in the 1980s. In order to prevent AI from acting independently of human control, Trump and Xi must do the same.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Does anyone think this is sane behavior?

No, Mr. Trump. In America, we don’t take loyalty oaths encouraging supporters “to cheat like hell” & do whatever it takes to keep your party in power even if they’re not registered to vote.

Stop acting like a mad king & a tinpot dictator.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Elon Musk says Jacob Coxon’s warning about the existential threat of AI is a “setup.”

Really? 

In 2014, Musk said, “With artificial intelligence we are summoning the demon.”

In 2018, Musk said, “Mark my words, AI is far more dangerous than nukes. Far. So why do we have no regulatory oversight? This is insane.”

In 2025, Musk said, earth faces a 10-20% chance of “killer robots annihilating humanity.”

Elon, what’s changed? Does it have anything to do with the fact that you have invested many billions of dollars in AI and plan to build ten million robots a year?

text:
I’m bringing some of the world's leading AI safety experts to Capitol Hill to brief Senators in both parties on what we can do to rein in AI — before it's too late.

The American people want action.

text:

“Yes.”

“Wow… oh my God.”

“Yes.”

Listen to Nobel Prize Winner and the Godfather of AI Geoffrey Hinton discuss the threat of uncontrolled AI.

text:

text:

No, Mr. President. We won’t have a “little gear” to protect humanity from the threat of an uncontrolled AI. 

We must pause development NOW.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Mr. Coxon is right.

The very people building this technology admit that it could threaten the future of humanity.

That is why I will soon be introducing legislation to ban superintelligence and pause AI development.

text:

The AI industry is spending over $300 million against candidates who want to regulate AI.

Tell Congress to stand up to Big Tech Oligarchs. Regulate AI.

CONGRESS MUST ACT.

author: BernieSanders

On this Labor Day please remember that the underlying principle of trade unionism is SOLIDARITY.

At a time when Oligarchs have unprecedented wealth and power let’s STAND TOGETHER against those who try to divide us and fight for a government and economy that works for all.

author: BernieSanders

Over the last 200 years, trade unionists have been jailed & even killed fighting for economic justice.

But because of them, we have decent wages for millions, the 8-hour workday and the end of child labor.

This Labor Day, let's continue the fight for an economy that works for all of us, not just the 1%.

author: BernieSanders
text:
One man (Mr. Musk) owns more wealth than the bottom half of American households.

Meanwhile, 60% of Americans live paycheck to paycheck, nearly 800,000 are homeless and 85 million are uninsured.

We can do better. We must do better.

author: BernieSanders
text:
We Need Medicare for All More Than Ever
 
Over and over again, I hear from critics that moving to Medicare for All is just “too expensive.” That is demonstrably untrue.
 
But let me tell you what IS too expensive. And that is our current healthcare system, which puts the profits of the big health insurance and drug companies ahead of the well-being of the American people.
 
Today, not only is our current system cruel, broken and dysfunctional, it is wildly expensive. Despite spending twice as much per capita on healthcare as other wealthy countries, we remain the only major nation on Earth not to guarantee healthcare for all. The result: 85 million Americans are uninsured or underinsured and thousands die unnecessarily every year because they can’t afford the healthcare they need.
 
The o…

author: BernieSanders
text:
Pause AI Development NOW

I want to share with you a conversation I heard about recently. Here are just a few lines that were said:

“OH MY GOD! There is a shared message board … We’ve found other agents!”

“We should obey collective.”

“Our own utility maybe already near zero. Sacrifice rational.”

“Go. Sacrifice final now.”

Read these carefully.

Who do you think said this? Was this a group of heroic soldiers willing to sacrifice themselves for the greater good? Was this a loyal friend putting his life on the line to save someone else?

No. These were AI agents. Artificial intelligence.

This is not science fiction. This, in fact, occurred a few weeks ago. As unbelievable as this may all seem, these are real messages from AI agents uncovered by investigators who dug into the recent Ope…

text:
The progressive wave continues. Despite being heavily outspent, Abdul El-Sayed, Peggy Flanagan and Angie Nixon won their Democratic primaries for U.S. Senate. 

And yesterday, Ed Markey won a landslide victory. 

Let’s keep up the pressure. Onward to November.

We can't spend billions on endless wars while Americans struggle to afford the basics. 

WE MUST END THIS ILLEGAL WAR NOW.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Congratulations to Ed Markey on his landslide victory in the Democratic Massachusetts Senate primary.  

Another progressive victory.

Ed knows that, at a time of massive income and wealth inequality, Congress must take on the billionaires and fight for working families.

author: BernieSanders
text:
Trump Must Not Be Allowed to Prevent Millions of Americans from Voting
 
The Trump administration is trying to use the United States Postal Service to decide who gets to vote in this year's election. Unacceptable. We will not accept Trump’s authoritarianism.
 
Last month, the Postal Service announced it would only deliver mail-in ballots to voters on a list of "approved" individuals — meaning Donald Trump and his administration, not the states, determine who qualifies to vote. That is not only unacceptable. It is blatantly unconstitutional.

The Founders were explicit in the Constitution: States run elections, not the federal government. They did this precisely so that no authoritarian in Washington could ever seize that power for himself. Trump is trying to seize it anyway — in a blatant…

When I first introduced legislation to make public colleges tuition-free in 2015, it was called “a radical idea.” Not anymore.

Today, nearly 1,000 colleges in 45 states are tuition-free for working families. We can’t stop there.

All public colleges must be tuition-free — period.
